fullContentHtml:
NEET PG Result 2026 – Full Details

National Board Of Examinations In Medical Sciences (NBEMS) has released the result for the NEET MD/MS/PG Diploma Admission Test 2026. Applications for the NEET PG Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted From 01 July 2026, to 21 July 2026. The online examination is was held on 30 August 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can check their NEET PG Admit Card 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 30 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 August 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 25 August 2026
  • Result Declared : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 3500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 2500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Result

  • Download Admit Card
  • Check Admit Card Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Information Brochure
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NEET PG Result 2026?

NEET PG Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
